g.text: Both operations, both datasets, one direction

g.text: The units differ: ours in share of switches, Zach's in points. Read the sign and the order, not the size.
Empty cells: Muse too few switches; Lightning not tested (gate); 122B not run (3 cells).
Hollow marks: Lightning's gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
122B: FP8; MoE, ~10B active; L33 (the 27B's relative depth carried over).
control: a random part (same size); his: rotated directions
